title: The Third Well
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：resource　|　正文 304 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 resource 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① resource everybody in the valley argues about is water, and the ② resource nobody mentions is time: it takes eleven years to know whether a well will last, and nobody in authority has eleven years. My grandfather, who had no money and no influence and a great deal of ③ resource, dug the village's third well in 1974 with a borrowed pump and no permission.

He was not a man of learning; he was a man who had watched the ground for forty-one years. What the county called ④ resource management in its reports was, in his hands, a matter of where the grass grew greener in June, and he said a resource is not a thing you have but a thing you can keep.

The ⑤ resources of the valley, as the 1979 survey listed them, were water, timber and eleven hundred acres of grazing, and the survey said all three could be increased at once, which my grandfather said was the sentence that proved nobody had read the ground.

He had ⑥ no resources of his own beyond the pump and his two hands, and he used both, and he never once mentioned either. The well is still there and has never failed, not in the drought of 1989 and not in 2003. In 2011 the council fenced it and listed it as an emergency ⑦ resource, which would have amazed him, because it had been the ordinary village resource for forty-one years.

As a last ⑧ resource, my grandfather used to say, you can always ask the ground; it answers slowly and it does not lie. He died in 1996. The ⑨ learning resource the school built in his name in 2015 is a computer room, which he would have found hilarious. The ⑩ resource I actually inherited from him was the habit of looking at grass in June.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 资源（natural / water resources）
B. n.[pl.] 资源；财力；物力（the resources to do sth.）
C. n. （学习、信息等）资源；资料（a learning resource）
D. 固定搭配：as a last resource 作为最后的办法
E. n.[U] 机智；应变之才（a man of resource）
F. 固定搭配：natural resources 自然资源
G. 固定搭配：resource management 资源管理
H. n. 备用资源；储备（an emergency resource）

items.q: The resource everybody in the valley argues about is water
the resource nobody mentions is time
What the county called resource management
The resources of the valley, as the 1979 survey listed them
He had no resources of his own
listed it as an emergency resource
As a last resource, my grandfather used to say
The learning resource the school built in his name
The resource I actually inherited from him

answers.why: the resource ... is water 指自然资源中大家争论的那一项，即水。
resource 意为“资源”，说没人提到的资源是时间。
resource 意为“机智、应变之才”，祖父没钱没势，却足智多谋。
resource management 意为“资源管理”，县里报告里的说法在他手里就是看六月哪里的草更绿。
resources 复数意为“资源、物力”，1979 年调查列出的山谷资源是水、木材和牧场。
resources 意为“财力、物力”，他除了那台水泵和双手之外一无所有。
an emergency resource 意为“应急储备”，议会 2011 年把这口井列为应急资源。
as a last resource 意为“作为最后的办法”，祖父说最后还可以去问土地。
a learning resource 意为“学习资源、教学设施”，学校以他名字建的那间是电脑室。
the resource I inherited 意为“我继承到的资源／财富”，指在六月看草的习惯。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 山谷里人人争论的资源是水。（resource）
没人提到的资源是时间。（resource）

作为最后的办法，你总可以去问土地。（as a last resource）
answers: The resource everybody in the valley argues about is water.
The resource nobody mentions is time.
My grandfather had no money and no influence and a great deal of resource.
What the county called resource management was, in his hands, a matter of where the grass grew greener in June.

answers: The resource everybody in the valley argues about is water, and the resource nobody mentions is time.
